description: What L2 cache policies do on GB10: whether a buffer's lines survive a 96 MB stream by how the buffer was loaded (default read, evict-last read, the windows' evict-last bulk prefetch) and how the stream reads (default, evict-first), at persisting-L2 set-asides from 0 to the device's maximum; and the set-aside's cost to default reuse with stale persisting lines. A script: its exit status is the verdict; the table is the result.
